title: Towns with an asteroid: the places on Earth that have a minor planet
excerpt: I mapped 2,193 asteroids (2,206 namings) named after places on Earth, each with a line to the observatory that found it. Japan has the most, Finland the most per head, and small observatories name the next valley.
seo_description: 2,193 asteroids named after towns, rivers and mountains, mapped with lines to the observatories that found them.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Towns with an asteroid' in black and red on parchment, beside a map of Europe, Africa and Asia covered in small coloured dots joined by faint arcs to black stars, with the lines '2,193 minor planets (2,206 namings) named after places on Earth' and 'Japan: 421. Finland: 11.8 per million people. The UK: 26.'
